title: 26 January 1961: Live: Litherland Town Hall, Liverpool
content:
This was The Beatles’ third show at Litherland Town Hall, where they had given a triumphant homecoming performance on 27 December 1960, following their first trip to Hamburg.

The Beatles played at the venue on 20 separate occasions between December 1960 and 9 November 1961.

Page last updated: 24 January 2024

  • 1970: John Lennon is interviewed in Paris by Reuters

  • 1970: Ringo and Maureen fly to Los Angeles
  • 1969: John Lennon signs management contracts with Allen Klein
  • 1969: Get Back/Let It Be sessions: day 17
  • 1965: George Martin breaks his foot in the Swiss Alps

  • 1962: The Beatles live: Tower Ballroom, New Brighton, Wallasey
  • 1962: The Beatles live: Cavern Club, Liverpool (evening)
